items.text: A fulfilling life is primarily achieved through:

options.B: Primarily inner work, with some external achievement
options.C: Both inner development and external achievement equally
options.D: Primarily external achievement, with some inner cultivation

items.text: Person A: meditates daily, cultivates inner peace, few external accomplishments. Person B: built a successful company, transformed an industry, experiences constant anxiety. Who lived better?

options.A: Person A—inner peace is what truly matters
options.B: Person A probably, though B's impact has value
options.C: Impossible to judge—different but equally valid paths
options.D: Person B probably, though A's peace has value
options.E: Person B—impact on the world is what truly matters

items.text: Is introspection overrated or underrated in modern society?

options.A: Severely underrated—we need much more self-reflection
options.E: Severely overrated—we need less navel-gazing, more doing
